WINNING STEPS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P C Ng this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg. Before being allowed to race again, WINNING STEPS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

General

1.

After the running of Race 2, the track classification was officially changed from "Good” to "Good to Firm”. This change in the opinion of the Stewards should be recorded as being retrospective. As a consequence of this, the official results will show Races 1 and 2 being run on a track rated "Good to Firm”.
